title: Horsepower Calculator
description: 2 captured saves. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: HORSEPOWER
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Increasing lines; common pointer base 17125; exact end marker/EOF; byte-identical left/right payload
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
10 PRINT"DO YOU WANT METRIC (1) OR ENGLISH (2) HORSEPOWER";
20 INPUTD
25 IFD=1THEN35
30 IFD=2THEN100
35 PRINT"FOR METIC H.P., ENTER IN THIS ORDER: HEIGHT(M), WEIGHT(NT),TIME(SEC);
50 INPUTM,N,T
60 H=(N*M)/(T*542.476)
70 GOTO200
100 PRINT"FOR ENGLISH H.P. ENTER IN THIS ORDER: HEIGHT(FT), WEIGHT(LBS.), TIME (SEC).";
110 INPUTF,L,S
120 H=L*M/(S*550)
200 PRINT"YOUR HORSEPOWER IS";H

versions.label: HORSEPOWER CALCULATOR
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end marker, byte-identical matching variants/repeated saves; runtime untested
versions.startupSource:
10 PRINT"DO YOU WANT METRIC (1) OR ENGLISH (2) HORSEPOWER";
20 INPUTD
25 IFD=1THEN35
30 IFD=2THEN100
35 PRINT"FOR METIC H.P., ENTER IN THIS ORDER: HEIGHT(M), WEIGHT(NT),TIME(SEC)";
50 INPUTM,N,T
55 IFM*N*T <=0 THEN35
60 H=(N*M)/(T*542.476)
70 GOTO200
100 PRINT"FOR ENGLISH H.P. ENTER IN THIS ORDER: HEIGHT(FT), WEIGHT(LBS.), TIME (SEC).";
110 INPUTF,L,S
115 IFF*L*S <=0 THEN 100

attribution.text: Original author and any earlier published source have not been established. Preserved here as recovered cassette material.
